falseSynonyms.zh: 收據不等於 coupon receipt 是付款後的購買證明；coupon 是付款前或付款時用來獲取優惠／兌換權。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A receipt records a purchase; a coupon changes the purchase terms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 票不等於所有 coupon ticket 通常賦予入場或乘搭權；coupon 通常提供折扣或兌換優惠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A ticket grants access or travel; a coupon usually grants a discount or offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 禮品卡不等於一般 coupon gift card 通常有預付餘額；coupon 多數是折扣或特定優惠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A gift card stores value; a coupon usually reduces price or grants an offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會員卡不等於 coupon 會員卡證明會員身份；優惠可能透過會員卡獲得，但卡本身不是 coupon。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A membership card identifies eligibility; a coupon is a specific offer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 回贈不等於 coupon rebate 通常在購買後退回部分金額；coupon 通常在購買時直接減價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A rebate is often claimed after purchase; a coupon is usually applied at purchase.

falseSynonyms.zh: 優惠不等於 coupon offer 是促銷條件本身；coupon 是獲取／兌現優惠的一種工具。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An offer is the deal; a coupon is one mechanism for receiving it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 代幣不等於所有 coupon token 可以是實體／數碼憑證、遊戲代幣或象徵物；只有在 money-off / redeemable 語境才接近 coupon。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Token is broader; only some tokens function as coupons.

falseSynonyms.zh: voucher 和 coupon 很接近，但範圍不同 voucher 可代表預付價值、禮券、服務兌換；coupon 常更偏促銷折扣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Vouchers can carry value or entitlement; coupons often provide discounts.
